summary: Selected Scenario B (authsvc) for Technical Communication Launchpad because the workspace already has a live API-key auth surface, so reviews and docs can cite real 401/404/not_owner behavior instead of inventing a dashboard.
evidence: Scenario B constraints map to existing code: X-API-Key via API_KEY_A/API_KEY_B, JWT_SECRET is not an API-key alias, not_owner_status=404, public GET /r/{code}.

Precision of language is the teaching stake: tokens expire vs tokens revoked, 401 unauthenticated vs 404 not_found for another owner's code — those distinctions already exist in api/app/auth.py and the error envelope.

Default Scenario A (analytics dashboard) would force invented ClickHouse/GDPR docs. Authsvc reuses System Design M04/M05 artifacts: module04_auth_verify.py, redact_secrets, error envelope {error:{code,message,request_id}}.
